justification: Inspected core/src/main/java/org/adoptopenjdk/jitwatch/parser/zing/ZingLine.java and core/src/main/java/org/adoptopenjdk/jitwatch/parser/zing/ZingLogParser.java. ZingLine is 264 lines with 30 public methods, but they are mostly accessors plus a small set of closely related helpers for one domain concept: a parsed Zing compilation line. Its extra behavior is cohesive (signature parsing and three tag/task export methods), and ZingLogParser delegates those conversions to it rather than splitting unrelated responsibilities across the class, so I found no strong evidence of insufficient modularization.
